newsitem.title: UK: Dixons gains as retail sector bounces.
newsitem.headline: Dixons gains as retail sector bounces.

text.p: Shares in electrical retailer Dixons Group Plc gained on Tuesday as retail stocks bounced off recent lows, after being dogged by fears that Wednesday's budget could contain measures to curb consumer spending, dealers said.
Dixon shares rose 12-1/2p to 479-1/2p by 1351 GMT in turnover of 1.5 million shares.

Dealers said shares in leading high street stores climbed as bargain hunters snapped up stock after recent falls caused by worries that the government could target consumers with an interest rate hike as well as by raising taxes.
Shares in Kingfisher Plc advanced 16p to 698p, Boots Plc rose 10-1/2p to 714p, Marks and Spencer Plc gained 9-1/2p to 507-1/2p and Argos Plc nudged up 6p to 553-1/2p.
